$comment: The token harvest catalog (2026-11-24): every model source a databayt machine may draw on, classified. One source of truth: Machine -> Providers lists these rows and runs their readiness steps (provider.<id>), scripts/harvest/combos.mjs builds the OmniRoute combos from `roles`, harvest.mjs reads their quota back into ~/.claude/state/harvest.json, and the `lane` dispatcher tests them. Per person: every key is the teammate's OWN account, stored in their OS credential store under Machine's service `org.databayt.kun.machine`, account = `keychain` (an env-style name, the same item Machine → Brain writes), never shared. tier: keyless (no account) | free (account, no card) | free-capped (free with a hard daily/request cap) | paid (needs money; off until `enabled` and a /decide record) | plan (a subscription — never pooled). privacy: free providers may read prompts — `public` work only (no client data, no secrets). `limits` are what the provider publishes, checked 2026-11-24 (OmniRoute docs/reference/PROVIDER_REFERENCE.md + the provider's page); OmniRoute's live quota is the truth at runtime.

providers.name: Nous Portal (free models)
providers.login: Hermes holds the Nous Portal login. Its agent key lives one hour, so omni.mjs reads a fresh one from Hermes (kun-free.sh --key) and harvest.mjs pushes it into the OmniRoute connection every run (30 min). f --direct and Hermes itself use Nous without the pool.

limits.note: free models: longcat-2.5, hy4-flash, solar-mini4, step-3.7-flash

providers.bench: 2026-11-24 tool task: longcat 26s PASS, hy4-flash 28s PASS, solar-mini4 50s PASS, step-3.7-flash timeout
providers.note: 2026-11-26: meituan/longcat-2.5:free removed by Nous (404 'no longer available'); its 404 locked the whole connection.

combos.$comment: The classes. combos.mjs builds each OmniRoute combo from the enabled providers' `roles` in this order, strategy priority (best member first; OmniRoute moves to the next when one is exhausted, rate-limited or failing), paid rungs last and only when enabled. Re-rank after `lane test --pool`. Ranking today (2026-11-24 bench): Nous longcat 25s, Cloudflare gpt-oss-120b 206s through Claude Code; re-rank when NVIDIA/OpenRouter/Gemini/Groq/Mistral keys are in.
